shards.evidence_basis: Small suite has no Reference full-generation or replay fixture.
Predictor and guard fixtures use lightweight deterministic model artifacts; optional heavyweight V-JEPA inference is excluded.
Legacy teaching-workbench tests use bounded deterministic fixtures and no Reference generation or replay.
Core domain tests include bounded generation fixtures but exclude full publication, capacity runtime, replay, and calibration-fit execution.
One module-scoped scenario generation and one full runtime feed both capacity assertions; no replay or publication fixture is stacked.
One module-scoped full execution and publication build feed all publication assertions; regeneration redraws figures but does not rerun the mission.
Calibration tests verify frozen reports and adverse benchmark receipts; they do not execute either 100-seed fit. Scale and statistics use constructed bounded fixtures.
Pipeline performs three deterministic generations; runtime-factory tests share one generated scenario and run only the initial decision horizon. No complete mission replay is executed.
The isolated characterization module required approximately 38 minutes in GitHub coverage execution before the prior workflow was canceled.
The isolated registered G3 execution target required approximately 458 seconds without coverage and has no stacked heavy fixture.
One module fixture performs faulted execution plus restart; registered integrity execution required approximately 458 seconds without coverage.
Five initial-horizon mission tests share one generated scenario; no complete replay fixture is included.
The service-outcome execution is isolated from restart, fault, and replay fixtures; the registered target required approximately 204 seconds without coverage.
The two registered delivery/provider fault checks share generation only and are isolated from restart, outcome, and replay fixtures.
The uninterrupted/restart and registered crash/restart targets required approximately 414 and 421 seconds without coverage; no other heavy fixture is stacked.
One full execution supplies bundle and input-binding assertions; hidden scan, tamper, publication, and replay are separate jobs.
One full execution supplies a streaming hidden-identifier scan; the registered scan required approximately 300 seconds without coverage.
One full execution is shared by artifact tamper, manifest-model tamper, and symlink checks; the registered tamper target required approximately 295 seconds without coverage.
One source execution plus one exact regeneration and byte comparison is isolated; registered exact replay required approximately 540 seconds without coverage.
Phase 6 model checks are lightweight; the only generation-heavy test builds the eight registered axis variants and does not execute full runtime/replay/publication.
